note: Weights are planning priorities, not measured quality. A workstream percentage is derived from machine-checkable evidence probes only; it must never be raised by writing prose, adding files, or counting tests.

workstreams.title: Runtime and cognitive-cycle integrity
workstreams.endGoal: One traceable Perceive->Plan->Gate->Act->Observe->Reflect->Consolidate path with no unverified bypass and a single versioned state.

workstreams.title: Memory correctness and independent retrieval evidence
workstreams.endGoal: MemoryOS2 as the single owner, with proven recallDelta > 0 on an immutable RU/EN holdout across paired seeds, plus correct abstention and forgetting.

workstreams.title: Learning, outcome verification and promotion authority
workstreams.endGoal: Learning credit only from independently verified outcomes; promotion gated by signed evidence, held-out transfer and rollback.

workstreams.title: Structural self-analysis and self-modification safety
workstreams.endGoal: The organism can read its own code structurally and refuse any candidate that edits its evaluator, gates, holdout or approval authority.

workstreams.title: Intrinsic motivation, initiative and long-horizon continuity
workstreams.endGoal: Explainable self-initiated Perceive->Appraise->Plan->Act->Reflect cycles over soak, bounded by budget and stoppable by the user.

workstreams.title: Embodiment, voice and cross-renderer body switching
workstreams.endGoal: Voice and avatar follow one timeline driven by organism state; real browser and real device E2E pass with measured drift.

workstreams.title: Safety, danger understanding and privacy
workstreams.endGoal: Documented threat model, evaluator-tamper resistance, injection handling and least-privilege action execution with regression coverage.

workstreams.title: Evidence pipeline and CI reliability
workstreams.endGoal: Every claim maps to a reproducible artifact; CI runs and its results are visible, or a documented local gate substitutes with the limitation stated.

workstreams.title: Release, licensing and clean-room recovery
workstreams.endGoal: Human license review closed, exact-SHA ZIP built and published with checksum, clean-room install and rollback proven.
